info.title: Nest - Proportional Family Task Coordinator API
info.description: REST API documentation for Nest, a family productivity platform built on top of Supabase (PostgREST) and Supabase Auth. It supports capacity-aware task allocation, user timezone tracking, daily chore logs, and local/push notifications.

post.description: Creates a new user account with Supabase Auth. Upon completion, a corresponding profile record must be created in the `users` table.

400.description: Invalid email, password too short, or user already exists

post.description: Logs in the user using email and password, returning a JWT token for subsequent database requests.
Sends a password reset email to the specified user.

400.description: User email not found or malformed request

post.description: Revokes the active user session token.

get.description: Returns current Supabase Auth system user details (from JWT). Note that system metadata is returned; detailed profile attributes are fetched from the `/rest/v1/users` table endpoint.
Queries family member profiles. Filters can be applied to narrow search results (e.g. filter members by group).

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Filter by family group ID, e.g. `eq.7291a27e-cfc1-4b13-ba14-5b4d812328ba`

post.description: Inserts a new profile. Typically triggered by client-side signup flow.

patch.description: Updates fields on the user profile, such as display name, timezone, theme, preferred notification hour, or capacity percentage. Adults can edit any member in their group; Teens/Children can only edit themselves.

group_id.description: Set to null when leaving a group

get.description: Fetches details of the family group.

post.description: Initializes a family unit with default values. Creation auto-populates default chore lists via triggers/app setup logic.

patch.description: Updates group configuration, e.g., toggling auto-distribution logic (Adults only).

auto_distribution.description: Toggle to distribute tasks automatically via weekly cron rotations

get.description: Resolves invite links for validating code joining or displaying details to creators.

post.description: Generates a temporary 8-character joining code valid for 24 hours.

patch.description: Updates array of user IDs who have successfully signed up and redeemed this invite token.

used_by.description: Updated log of UUIDs who used this code

get.description: Queries group chores. Allows sorting/searching (e.g. active tasks at the top, sorted by cost and alphabetical order).

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Filter chores belonging to a specific group

post.description: Adds a new chore structure to the catalog. Chores can either be auto-distributed (greedy workload balance) or statically/manually pinned to a user.

available_for.description: Age-appropriate constraints indicating eligible user types

assigned_to.description: Assigned user ID. Null if auto=true.

auto.description: Set to true to use greedy auto-distribution, false for static manual assignment

patch.description: Updates details of a chore in the catalog.

delete.description: Deletes the chore definition and automatically cascades to delete all future/today pending assignments.

get.description: Retrieves user and family assignments. Query parameters enable filtering by week start (for stats) or by date (for 'To Do' lists).

parameters.name: assigned_to
parameters.description: Filter assignments by member ID, e.g., `eq.3d47e384-5f11-482a-a92c-0e24177b960b`

parameters.name: week_start
parameters.description: Filter assignments starting on specific week (Monday ISO date), e.g. `eq.2026-06-01`

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter by assignment date (ISO date), e.g. `eq.2026-06-03`

post.description: Inserts manually created assignments or logs task events.

patch.description: Updates the status of an assignment. Adults can update any assignment; Teens/Children can only mark their own tasks as done.

delete.description: Removes scheduled assignments (usually applied when deleting tasks or re-shuffling chores).

get.description: Returns in-app notifications. Typically ordered descending by date and limited to the 20 most recent entries.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Filter notifications for specific user, e.g., `eq.3d47e384-5f11-482a-a92c-0e24177b960b`

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max limits (usually set to 20 for list rendering)

patch.description: Updates read status of user notifications.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Update targets for the authenticated user, e.g., `eq.3d47e384-5f11-482a-a92c-0e24177b960b`

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by notification ID, e.g., `eq.ba14-5b4d812328ba-7291a27e` (if marking single item read)

is_read.description: Set to true to mark notification(s) as read

post.description: Executes the server-side PL/pgSQL distribution engine. It loops through active groups, balances weekly active auto-assigned chores proportionally based on remaining capacity of eligible member roles, creates daily assignments, and emits notifications.
Marks past pending assignments (date < today in group creator's timezone) as skipped.

Processes push notifications for users whose preferred `notification_time` matches current local hour in their timezone. Compiles daily assignments, yesterday's skipped tasks, or weekly reports, inserts notification records, and dispatches push requests via Expo Push Notification service.

select.name: select
select.description: Select columns to return, e.g., `*` or `id,name,email`

prefer.name: Prefer
prefer.description: Preference header for PostgREST actions, e.g. `return=representation` to return updated rows.

UserType.description: The category of family member determining access control and assignment eligibility.

AssignmentStatus.description: Current status of the daily chore assignment.

resource.description: Capacity weight percentage. Determines proportion of group workload allocated to the user.

group_id.description: The ID of the group the user belongs to. Null if they are not in a group.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier used for scheduling

notification_time.description: Preferred hour of daily notifications in format HH:00

expo_push_token.description: Expo push notification token for mobile devices

created_by.description: User ID of group creator (Adult administrator)

auto_distribution.description: Toggle to shuffle chores weekly using greedy task-allocation engine

group_id.description: Family group associated with the invite link

used_by.description: User IDs who registered or joined using this token

emoji.description: Representative emoji icon for the task

available_for.description: Allowed member types for this chore

assigned_to.description: Specific user ID assigned to task. Null if auto=true and unassigned.

auto.description: True if auto distribution is active. False if statically assigned.

is_active.description: Only active tasks are generated and auto-distributed.

assigned_to.description: User ID of the family member who must perform the task

week_start.description: ISO date string of week's Monday (used for weekly aggregation)

date.description: ISO date of the specific day this instance is active

access_token.description: JWT access token used in Authentication bearer headers

refresh_token.description: Token used to request a new access token
